results.description:
Goodreads is the free book tracker and reading community for everyone who loves books. With more than 150 million members, it is the world's largest community of readers. Keep track of everything you've read, discover your next favorite book, save it to your Want to Read shelf, and update your reading progress as you go. Then share your shelves and progress with friends who love books as much as you do. Rate and review books, read honest reviews from other readers, join book club groups, and talk about the stories you can't stop thinking about.

Behind all those conversations is a book tracker that makes staying organized easy. Add a book in seconds by scanning the cover or searching by title, author, or ISBN. Add it to your Want to Read, Currently Reading, Read, or Did Not Finish (DNF) shelf, or create your own book lists for beach reads, favorite series, or the books your friends keep recommending. Want to read more this year? Set a personal goal with the Reading Challenge, adjust it anytime, and follow along as friends work toward theirs. Take on seasonal challenges and watch your reading tracker fill up as you go. When the year ends, Year in Books recaps every page you read.

Reading is better with company. Follow friends to discover what they're reading and find more books to read, rate the books you finish, and check reviews from millions of readers before you pick your next one. Join a book club through Goodreads groups to read along and share your thoughts, or recommend a favorite to a friend who needs it. You can even vote for your favorite books of the year in the Goodreads Choice Awards.

GOODREADS FEATURES

FREE BOOK TRACKER, LOG & LISTS

• Rate books with half, quarter or whole stars, share your review, and like or comment on reviews from other readers.
• Book Scanner: Scan a cover or search by title, author, or ISBN to add any book to your book tracker in seconds.
• Reading tracker: Organize your Read, Currently Reading, and Want to Read shelves, plus custom book lists for any genre or mood.
• Did Not Finish shelf: Keep track of the books you set aside, so your reading history tells the whole story.
• Update your progress by page or percentage and keep a book log of every title you finish.
• Set a yearly reading goal with the Reading Challenge and earn achievements in seasonal challenges.
• Look back on your Year in Books, a recap of every book from your reading tracker.

DISCOVER NEW BOOKS TO READ

• Get personalized recommendations based on the books you've read and loved. With millions of ratings and reviews, discover what's trending this week in your favorite genres, from romance to historical fiction, and find new books to read.
• Get ahead of the next big release with our Most Anticipated Books lists, based on what readers are adding to their Want to Read shelves, plus author interviews and featured lists.
• Use the Book Scanner at the bookstore or library to pull up ratings and reviews instantly and decide if it's your next read.

READING COMMUNITY & BOOK CLUBS

• Connect with a reading community of more than 150 million members.
• Join book club groups to start discussions and meet readers who share your taste.
• Keep up with what friends add to their shelves and how their reading goals are going.
• Recommend books to friends and vote for your favorites in the Goodreads Choice Awards.

Whether you're logging your latest read or discovering your next obsession, Goodreads is the free reading tracker made for readers like you. Join the community and start building your shelves today.

By using this app, you agree to Goodreads’s Terms of Use (https://www.goodreads.com/about/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.goodreads.com/about/privacy).

Meet Readict
Readict is a virtual library of completely addicting novels that will get you reading like never before! Whether you're a romance fanatic, a paranormal enthusiast, or just looking for something fun to do, you'll always find a story to enjoy on Readict.
Readict has many in-app features to cater to your reading preferences. There's a variety of menus and pages to help you find your next book, such as Editor's Choice, Hot Genres, New and Trending, and Popular on Readict. And, in addition to saving your progress in a personal library, once you start reading, the app will suggest more stories based on the titles you've liked. Readict tailors your reading recommendations to your tastes so you can make the most of our large library of fantastic books. Read anytime and anywhere with Readict!

There's something for everyone on Readict! Some of our top stories include:

Not Rejected Just Unwanted
All Raine Andrew wanted was a mate. She wanted a mate to love her and make her feel wanted. And when she turns 17, she gets her mate: soon-to-be-Beta Elijah Woods. He's a great guy. He's loyal to his pack, a straight-A student, and a very hard worker.
He sounds like the perfect mate, right? Raine thought so too, but there's just one problem: He doesn't want her.

Mated to My Bully
Amanda Stevens thought her problems were over when she got to college. No longer the shy, awkward teen she was in high school, Amanda felt this was her chance at making new friends and experiencing life. That was until she found out her high school Bully was attending the same college she was. Hudson Harlow. 
The moment that Hudson Harlow looked into the hazel eyes of Amanda Stevens, his wolf started to howl MATE! Why in the world would the Moon Goddess mate him to a human? But Hudson started to notice that this was no longer the girl that he tormented in High School. She'd changed. 
Hudson, knowing how awfully he treated Amanda in high school, had to now convince her to forgive him and accept him as her mate. 
Not only did Amanda have to deal with Hudson, but she also had to juggle her classes, a new job, and strange animal attacks on campus. All Amanda wanted was a normal college life.

His Broken Luna
Battered, abused, and broken, Sophia Alden is resigned to living the rest of her life as a slave to Alexander, a powerful Alpha who considers her his property and is dangerously obsessed with her. 
But when the Alpha of the most powerful pack comes to claim his true mate, hearts are broken, dangerous enemies are made, and Sophia finds herself thrust into a world of lies, lust, secrets, and desires that threatens to douse her in its burning flame, consuming her entire being.

All of these and more will be at your fingertips. Download Readict today!

Eppika is a language learning app with books and stories adapted to your level. Build reading comprehension, vocabulary, and listening skills through meaningful content instead of repetitive drills.

Want to learn Spanish by reading or improve another language through graded readers? Choose a book, read or listen for 10-15 minutes, tap unfamiliar words for instant translations, and learn vocabulary naturally in context.

Learn the language you want, whether it’s Spanish, English, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Turkish, Greek, Czech, or Polish. Spanish is available in both European and Latin American variants.

Join a growing community of 15,000+ learners who use Eppika to make reading part of their language-learning routine. With a 4.8 App Store rating based on 700+ ratings, Eppika offers an engaging alternative to repetitive exercises, helping learners stay motivated through stories, native audio, instant translations, and level-adapted books.

Graded readers for language learners

Eppika offers graded readers based on familiar books, classics, stories, and practical nonfiction. Every text is adapted for levels A1–B2, with vocabulary and grammar matched to the right difficulty.

Beginners can start reading without feeling lost, while more experienced learners can progress to richer, more complex texts. Each book is challenging enough to help you improve but clear enough to enjoy.

Audiobooks for language learning

Use Eppika to read and listen in Spanish, English, French, German, or another available language. Native audio helps improve listening comprehension and pronunciation while developing a better sense of the language’s natural rhythm.

Switch to Audiobook Mode when you want to learn during a walk, commute, workout, or before bed.

Instant word translation

Tap any unfamiliar word for an instant translation without leaving the story. Understand new vocabulary exactly when you need it and keep reading without switching to an external dictionary or translating every sentence.

Vocabulary in context

Build vocabulary in context by learning words and phrases inside memorable stories. Seeing how words are used makes their meaning easier to understand and remember.

Vocabulary tracking helps you follow your progress without relying on isolated flashcards or endless vocabulary lists.

Adapted books and stories by level

Explore 120+ adapted books and stories in more than 1,800 level-based versions. Start with familiar global titles, then discover classics, literature, practical nonfiction, biography, psychology, productivity, and more.

Make reading a daily language habit

Eppika fits into short breaks and busy schedules. A focused 10-15-minute session can combine reading, listening, translation, and meaningful progress without points, streaks, or cartoon-style gamification.

Who is Eppika for?

• Beginners looking for graded readers that do not feel overwhelming
• Intermediate learners who want to improve fluency and overcome a plateau
• Upper-intermediate learners who want to strengthen comprehension and expand vocabulary
• Busy professionals and travelers looking for meaningful daily practice
• Book lovers who prefer learning languages through stories instead of traditional lessons

How it works

1. Choose the language you want to learn.
2. Select a graded book or story.
3. Set your reading level from A1 to B2.
4. Read or listen, translate unfamiliar words, and build vocabulary in context.

Whether you are learning for travel, work, study, culture, or the joy of reading, Eppika helps you turn books into daily language practice.

Download Eppika and start learning languages through stories today.

results.description:
Kalshi is the largest legal and federally regulated prediction market app in the U.S., where you can make money by predicting real-world events, including soccer, baseball, golf, and other sports. Trade real outcomes in a federally regulated prediction market. Perfect for sports trading, event trading, forecasting, futures-style markets, and real-world predictions.

It’s like trading stocks — but instead, you trade on events you understand. Predict whether an event will happen or not, and earn money if you’re right.
Join 10M+ users trading thousands of prediction markets across finance, weather, culture, sports, and more. 

FINANCIAL MARKETS
Daily S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, WTI oil

ECONOMIC MARKETS
Fed interest rates, Inflation (CPI), GDP, Recession, Gas prices, Mortgage rates

CLIMATE MARKETS
Hurricane strength, Daily city temperatures, Tornado numbers

CULTURE MARKETS
Billboard 100, Oscars, Grammys, Emmys, #1 Hits

HOW KALSHI WORKS
Kalshi is the largest federally regulated prediction exchange where you buy and sell contracts based on event outcomes. Example: NASA announces a manned mission to the moon. Contract prices reflect trader probability estimates. If you think the event will happen, you buy contracts. Contracts cost between 1¢ and 99¢ and can be sold anytime. At market close, each correct contract is worth $1.

TRADE SPORTS
Kalshi lets you trade on real sports outcomes across football, baseball, basketball, golf, MMA, tennis, and more.
Trade pro and college sports with highly liquid prediction markets. 

HOW IS KALSHI REGULATED?
Kalshi is federally regulated as a Designated Contract Market (DCM) by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). Kalshi’s affiliate, Kalshi Klear LLC, is a CFTC-regulated clearinghouse that holds member funds and clears trades.

TRADE YOUR CONVICTIONS
Find prediction markets that match your views. If you think a recession is coming, trade recession and S&P markets. Put your money behind your forecasts.

REDUCE FINANCIAL RISK
Hedge against events that could impact your finances. If you hold stocks, trade Fed and inflation markets to help protect your portfolio.

KALSHI VS. STOCKS
Event contracts are direct. You trade the outcome of an event, not the future stock price of a company. Profits are not tied to company performance. No pattern day trading restrictions. Trade as much or as little as you want, anytime. In stock trading, you can be right and still lose money due to market sentiment or news. Prediction markets remove that layer.

KALSHI VS. OPTIONS
Event contracts are simpler. Options pricing depends on multiple complex factors. Kalshi contracts reflect straightforward event probabilities. No time decay. If the event odds stay the same, contract value stays stable.

HOW MUCH MONEY DO I NEED TO START?
Open and maintain a Kalshi account for free. Prediction markets require less capital than traditional trading, making it easier to diversify without risking large amounts.

ADVANCED TOOLS & API ACCESS
Build trading algorithms in Python with starter code and a dedicated package. Start in minutes with documentation. Access open-source tools from the Kalshi developer community.

18+ only. Restrictions and eligibility requirements apply. Trading event contracts and trading leveraged products, including perpetual futures, involves significant risk and is not appropriate for everyone. Please carefully consider if it is appropriate for you in light of your personal financial circumstances. Kalshi products are not available in all jurisdictions. See kalshi.com/regulatory for more information.
Additional perpetual contract offerings are subject to applicable regulatory review and approval, and availability may vary.
Leverage amplifies both potential gains and potential losses, and losses can exceed the amount deposited. Leverage limits are determined by KalshiEX LLC or the FCM based on its own risk assessment and each customer's individual risk profile, and are subject to change.

No blame. Just a gentle place to stop, so a little of your scrolling turns into reading, day by day.

That book you've been meaning to read, a few pages at a time. A reading habit builds on its own. And a small companion, Pause-kun, grows with every page.

[ Free ]
• Sessions: pick "just N minutes" before you open. When time's up, the apps are blocked again
• Reading timer: paper or app. Time in Kindle, Audible, or Apple Books counts as reading too
• Pages instead of minutes: your social time shown as "about N pages of a book"
• Honest records: based on Screen Time measurements. No inflated numbers to scare you
• A companion that grows: books pile up behind Pause-kun as you pause and read
• Home Screen widget and a Lock Screen view while you read (Live Activity)
• Share card: the time you turned into reading, and your companion, in one image
• Today and this week at a glance

[ Pause Plus ]
The free version is enough for most days. Pause Plus is for people who want to cut back more seriously. It's available as a subscription or a one-time purchase.
• Push Mode: a block you can't lift for the period you choose
• Unlimited apps
• Reward Mode: after you finish, 24 hours with no limits on your blocked apps
• Monthly and yearly views, with a full year of history

Pause Plus yearly and monthly plans each come with a 1-month free trial.
Pause Plus one-time purchase: pay once, no auto-renewal.

[ Your privacy ]

results.description:
We read less and less. And yet, we've never needed reading more.

Here, we don't believe discipline, forcing yourself, or stats are what make you want to read. What makes you want to read is breaking free from the rules and stumbling onto books that truly pull you in. Our goal: put pleasure and emotion back at the heart of reading.

DISCOVER BOOKS THROUGH OTHERS

We don't need more books. We need books to start circulating between us again.
Follow the people you trust, the ones who inspire you. Discover what they read, told in their own words, their own emotions. "I loved it, it moved me" is worth a thousand times more than "4.1 stars." On swelv, one honest recommendation replaces thousands of anonymous reviews.

SHARE YOUR READS, WITH YOUR EMOTIONS

That book that touched you — want to pass it on? Do it, in your own words. No analysis, no essay. A simple "I loved it" is enough. Or say more, if you feel like it. 

YOUR LIBRARY, ALL IN ONE PLACE

Find everything you've read, and everything you dream of reading. A living library, yours — far from dashboards and counters. Keep a trace of the stories that stayed with you, and feed your desires as you discover more. What you've read tells where you come from; what you want to read shows where you're going.

A SELECTION THAT FEELS LIKE YOU, ONCE A MONTH

The more you share what you feel, the better swelv understands you. Once a month, we offer you a book selection shaped by your tastes, your emotions, how you've grown as a reader, and the books that move the people in your circle. The result: recommendations that are more personal, more nuanced, more true.

YOUR PROFILE

Not a book counter. Your reads, your favorites, what moved you. Enough to make others want to open the stories you loved.

READ WITH NO RULES

Reading for pleasure also means knowing how to close a book you're not enjoying. Nothing worse than forcing yourself out of guilt, and putting yourself off reading for two months. Pleasure reading flows: start, abandon, come back, read three books at once. It's not a competition. It's an experience.

PLAYLISTS, MADE BY HUMANS

Book selections brought together by people — around a theme, an emotion, a moment in life. No algorithm. Just taste, and personal experience.

Discover stories that feel like you. Read what you love. The habit will come on its own.

Written by popular self-help author Melody Beattie, More Language of Letting Go provides daily guidance and wisdom for those who struggle with codependency and want to change or leave a difficult relationship as well as those in recovery from an addiction. Many people who are looking to work on their personal growth or increase their peace and joy also find this app inspirational and helpful.

The app contains all 366 motivational readings from Beattie’s best-selling book, one for each day of the year. It is a companion to “The Language of Letting Go” and can be used by itself or in conjunction with that title. When the app is opened each day, it will automatically show you that day’s reading. Choose a time for a daily notification reminding you to read, reflect, and meditate on the reading.

Each daily reading focuses on a specific topic and ends with a related prayer or affirmation. Topics include: facing fears, getting to know yourself, dealing with grief, finding hope, recognizing manipulation, learning to have fun, and letting go of the things that are holding you back. Some readings feature activities to extend the experience.

Handy reference lists of the Twelve Steps of AA, the Twelve Traditions of AA, and the Twelve Steps of Al-Anon are also included in the app.

By integrating her own life experiences and fundamental recovery reflections, Melody Beattie helps readers take responsibility for themselves and their self-care as she encourages them to remember that each day is an opportunity for growth and renewal.

results.description:
The average person reads 250 words per minute. With proper training, you can double or triple that speed without sacrificing comprehension. OverRead is designed to unlock your brain's full potential and transform you into a more efficient reader.

  Two Powerful Reading Modes

  Highlighting Mode presents your complete text with a smooth, animated highlight moving at your chosen pace. You see the full context while the highlight guides your eyes, preventing regression and maintaining consistent speed.

  RSVP Mode takes a more aggressive approach. Words appear in the center of your screen, eliminating eye movement entirely. This removes one of the biggest physical limitations on reading speed, letting you reach speeds you never thought possible.

  Both modes offer adjustable speeds from 100 to 1000 words per minute. Start comfortable, then gradually increase as your abilities improve.

  Chunk Size Control

  Skilled readers process multiple words simultaneously. Adjust chunk size to control how many words appear together. Train your peripheral vision and develop the wide visual span that characterizes expert readers.

  Your Personal Library

  Build your collection from multiple sources. Paste text directly, import articles from any URL with automatic content extraction, or add EPUB books and PDF documents. Every item tracks your reading progress so you can pick up exactly where you left off.

  Comprehensive Statistics

  Track your daily reading time, weekly trends, completed articles, and average speed. The streak system encourages consistent practice. Regular training, even a few minutes daily, leads to significant improvements over time.

  Customizable Experience

  Four themes to match your preference: Modern, Classic, Sepia, and Dark. Adjust font and size for comfortable reading. Set default speed and mode so the app is ready when you are.

  Practice Templates

  Built-in content covering focus, productivity, learning techniques, and the science of speed reading. Quality practice material that teaches valuable skills while you train.

  OverRead+ Premium

  Unlock speeds up to 1000 WPM, unlimited library storage, progress saving across all content, and access to all themes.

  For Everyone Who Reads

  Students processing textbooks. Professionals staying current with industry news. Book lovers working through their reading lists. Anyone who reads regularly will benefit from speed reading training.
